📝 All the prompts used in this tutorial: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1eZQKbvtBt_AW7Bx99fRgR-27h_cyk1ayIidmmlMzDys/edit?usp=sharing

💁🏻 How to maintain voice consistency in Grok AI: https://youtu.be/N9iVUmvgWzU?si=HhlhdgpE7DLw3Xdp

📌 Here are the tools used in this tutorial:

1️⃣ To create story and scenes: https://chatgpt.com/

2️⃣ To create consistent characters: https://labs.google/fx/tools/whisk

3️⃣ To create lip-synced ai videos: https://grok.com/imagine

4️⃣ To generate narrator voiceovers: https://try.elevenlabs.io/5kttdatyf2en

5️⃣ To finalize ai video: https://www.canva.com/
————————————————————
In this video, I’m going to show you the exact Grok AI workflow I used to turn a simple story idea into fully animated scenes with lip-sync, where the characters stay identical across different emotions, camera angles, and lighting:

00:00: Intro
00:31: Create Your Story, Scenes and Characters In ChatGPT
02:06: Generate Consistent Characters In Google Whisk
04:28: Generate Lip-Synced AI Animations In Grok 
05:36: Generate Narrator Voiceovers In ElevenLabs
06:05: Final Editing In Canva
